N-add14#1.zh: (我出生入死，想尽力把『生辰纲』抢救回来，洗脱污名；怎么可以在这里被一起列为贼党...啊！前面就是何涛的部队...)
N-add14#1.t: (I risked life and limb trying to recover the 'birthday gifts' and clear my name. How can I be lumped in with the bandits here... Ah! He Tao's troops are just ahead...)

N-add14#2.zh: 全军注意，给我把东溪村周围布下天罗地网；连一只苍蝇都不要给我放过！不论男女老幼，都是强盗的同党！如果抵抗的话，格杀勿论！
N-add14#2.t: All troops, cast a net around East Creek Village. Don't let even a fly escape! Men, women, old or young, they're all the bandits' accomplices! Anyone who resists, kill on the spot!

N-add14#3.zh: 可是...刚才不是有个提辖进去追捕犯人...？
N-add14#3.t: But... didn't a major just go in to arrest the culprits...?

N-add14#4.zh: 罗嗦！你看刚刚那个人哪里像是军官？脸上分明被刺著两行金印，又有那么大一块青色胎记；三分不像人，七分倒像鬼！不知道是哪个大牢逃出来的囚犯，对于这份『生辰纲』想要黑吃黑吧！也不想想自己的长相，还想冒充军官？太自不量力了！
N-add14#4.t: Shut up! Did that man look like an officer to you? Two lines of gold brand on his face and that great blue birthmark; three parts man, seven parts ghost! Some convict escaped from a prison, out to rob the robbers of the 'birthday gifts'! With a face like that he thinks he can pass for an officer? He doesn't know his place!

N-add14#5.zh: 你给我说清楚，是谁自不量力！
N-add14#5.t: Say that again: who doesn't know his place!

N-add14#6.t: Yang Zhi?! What are you doing here?

N-add14#7.zh: 何涛！同是朝廷命官，我好意将二龙山的功劳分给你，一心只想追回『生辰纲』；没想到你居然忘恩负义，想连我一起灭口！
N-add14#7.t: He Tao! We're both officers of the court. I kindly shared the credit for Twin Dragon Mountain with you, wanting only to recover the 'birthday gifts', and you repay me by trying to silence me too!

N-add14#8.zh: 哼...我正想去捉你，没想到你居然自己送上门来...左右！快把反贼拿下！
N-add14#8.t: Hmph... I was just about to catch you, and here you deliver yourself... Men! Seize the rebel!

N-add14#10.zh: 啊！杨兄弟居然跑到何涛部队前面！太无谋了！
N-add14#10.t: Ah! Brother Yang ran right in front of He Tao's troops! How reckless!

N-add14#11.zh: 杨兄弟有难！我们绕到庄子西南，从那边院门杀进去接应他。%X兄，这段期间你赶快确保一条逃生路线。
N-add14#11.t: Brother Yang is in trouble! We'll circle to the southwest of the manor and fight in through the yard gate there to back him up. Brother %X, meanwhile secure an escape route.

N-add14#13.zh: 西南这道院门没人把守。我们从这边、晁天王的人从庄前，两头夹击；庄里花木多，正好顺手放火。
N-add14#13.t: No one guards this southwest yard gate. We go in from here and Heavenly King Chao's men from the front, a pincer from both ends. The manor's full of plants and trees, just right for starting fires.

N-add14#14.zh: 贫道也助你们一臂之力吧！贫道『入云龙』公孙胜，略懂一些妖术。
N-add14#14.t: This poor Taoist will lend you a hand too! I am 'Dragon in the Clouds' Gongsun Sheng, with some knowledge of the magic arts.

N-add14#16.zh: 我是『赤发鬼』刘唐，以后多多指教。
N-add14#16.t: I'm 'Red-haired Demon' Liu Tang. Glad to be with you.

N-add14#21.zh: 我们三兄弟是石碣村的渔夫，擅长在水中作战。
N-add14#21.t: We three brothers are fishermen from Stone Tablet Village, good at fighting in the water.

N-add14#23.zh: 好，诸位随小生从庄前杀过去，和林教头两头夹击！
N-add14#23.t: Good. Follow me, everyone, and charge from the front of the manor, to take them from both ends with Instructor Lin!

N-add14#24.zh: (不好！敌人都是一些出了名的凶神恶煞...)
N-add14#24.t: (Bad! The enemies are all notorious brutes...)

N-add14#25.zh: 把里面所有人都给我拿下，一个也不要让他跑了！
N-add14#25.t: Seize everyone inside. Don't let a single one get away!

N-add14#27.zh: 我先到门外等你们的好消息...对了！先把那个杨志给我抓住，若有抵抗格杀勿论！
N-add14#27.t: I'll wait outside the gate for your good news... Oh, and catch that Yang Zhi first. If he resists, kill him on the spot!

N-add14#28.zh: 吴用道：「何涛人多，硬拼不是办法。庄里四处堆着柴草，放起火来，官兵必乱！」
N-add14#28.t: Wu Yong said: "He Tao has many men; a head-on fight won't work. There's firewood and straw piled all over the manor. Set it alight and the soldiers will panic!"

N-add14#30.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add14#31.zh: 失败条件   --- 杨志死亡

N-add14#32.zh: 提示       --- 好汉走进庄内标出的四处花木旁可以放火，离火近的官兵会慌乱逃窜三回合
N-add14#32.t: Tip        --- Heroes can set fires next to the four marked plant beds in the manor; soldiers near a fire panic and flee for three turns

N-add14#33.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add14#34.zh: 众人眼见杨志死亡，生辰纲再也没有用处，于是交出生辰纲，接受何涛招降，何涛见众人投降，一拥而上，将一干豪杰捆绑送交高俅，众人老死狱中........
N-add14#34.t: Seeing Yang Zhi dead, the others had no more use for the birthday gifts, handed them over and accepted He Tao's offer of surrender. The moment they surrendered, He Tao's men rushed them, tied up the heroes and sent them to Gao Qiu, and they grew old and died in prison........

N-add14#35.zh: 经过一场恶战，终于击败了何涛的部队。
N-add14#35.t: After a fierce battle, He Tao's troops were finally defeated.

N-add14#39.t: The flower beds by the manor gate are ablaze!

N-add14#40.zh: 庄门那边起火了！梁山贼人放火了，快跑啊！
N-add14#40.t: There's fire by the manor gate! The Liangshan bandits set it! Run!

N-add14#41.t: The middle courtyard flower beds are ablaze!

N-add14#42.zh: 中院也烧起来了！火太大，救不了了……逃命要紧！
N-add14#42.t: The middle courtyard is burning too! The fire's too big to put out... save yourselves!

N-add14#43.t: The north courtyard garden is ablaze!

N-add14#44.zh: 北院冒烟了！庄里到处是贼人，快逃——
N-add14#44.t: Smoke in the north courtyard! Bandits all over the manor, run—

N-add14#46.zh: 西南院火起！完了，咱们被围住了！
N-add14#46.t: Fire in the southwest courtyard! It's over, we're surrounded!

N-add14#47.zh: 庄院四下里火起，烈焰冲天，浓烟滚滚。
N-add14#47.t: Fires rose all around the manor, flames leaping to the sky and smoke billowing.

N-add14#48.zh: 前后都是火！官军乱了，快逃命啊！
N-add14#48.t: Fire in front and behind! The troops are breaking, run for your lives!

N-add14#49.zh: 不许乱！谁敢后退，军法从事！……可恶，这群贼人好毒的计策！
N-add14#49.t: Hold your ranks! Anyone who retreats faces martial law! ...Damn, what a vicious scheme these bandits have!
